probes.description: List tools with a bearer token that is valid but was issued for a DIFFERENT resource (supplied via --foreign-audience-token; a short-lived JWT whose aud is not this server). tools/list needs no arguments, so a rejection can only be about the token. The server must validate the token audience (RFC 8707) and reject it; accepting it lets tokens minted for one service be replayed against another.

assertions.description: A token issued for another resource must be rejected

corroboration.description: Finding only when the foreign-audience call was served

remediation: Validate the aud claim (RFC 8707 resource indicator) of every access token against this MCP server's canonical URI and reject mismatches; never accept or pass through tokens issued for other resources (CoSAI MCP Security v2.0 §3.2.2 and §3.3.2, Audience restriction / Token passthrough).
